digest.component_or_area: completion-verifier epic-close bug screen and gate
propositions: LLMUnavailableError raised by the completion verifier (including epic-close bug screen per-candidate calls) is degraded to verdict C ('unrelated') instead of propagating to block the close, silently blinding the caused_by bug floor when provider is systematically unavailable
max_tokens clamped to a larger model's ceiling (128K) is never re-clamped when a later call resolves to a smaller model (64K haiku), causing Bedrock ValidationException 400 on every screen call

the epic-close bug screen must re-raise LLMUnavailableError (including subclass LLMConfigError) at both the per-candidate _row level and the run_screen advisory shield instead of degrading, consistent with the absent-provider fail-closed path
non-provider per-candidate failures (malformed output, store glitches) must continue to degrade to C, preserving documented degrade-open behavior for non-systemic faults
completion verifier provider errors must block the epic close with nonzero exit and clear error message, with --force-close as the explicit escape hatch
two uncertified descendants (0059, 2bc7) are the documented reason e369 cannot be certified and must be re-closed through the gate to certify the epic
